产品发布与更新.title: Google DeepMind launches institute to widen the AGI debate
产品发布与更新.snippet: The new institute aims to surface differing views between Google, Google DeepMind, and the broader global research community around AGI. "They will not always agree, and they will likely change their minds, as more data and information comes to light at the fast-moving frontier."
